title: Shopee / Lazada rules
keywords: shopee lazada collection 2-5pm delivery 3-7pm cut-off 9pm 95% 100% ushop mustafa dingtalk
body: Collection 2–5pm, delivery 3–7pm. Booking cut-off 9pm (Shopee later → day after next).
Lazada target 100%. Shopee ≥95% (5% movables may move 1 day; non-movables excluded).
Ushop and Mustafa follow the Lazada rules: complete the same day; cancel only if necessary.
Urgent and move-over Shopee jobs may be outsourced the same day.
Lazada via DingTalk (as soon as received, SLA 24 hrs); escalation tickets and confirmation portal within 48 hrs. Shopee escalation tickets: first response within 2 hrs.
